data.comment: AC3 decision: REMOVE (not deprecate) scan.py find-workitem. Blocker WL-0MSOMI4GQ009WL8E has landed in the installed wl CLI (v0.1.21; tolerant ID resolution verified live: `wl show SA-0MSOMINF8007K9S` resolves). Worklog lookups across all audit SCANNING prompts now route to native `wl list <term> --json` (substring) and `wl show <id> --json` (exact/unique-ID). The dual 'wl search or wl list' recommendation (from SA-0MSOIS36N0024ORI) is corrected to the single `wl list <term> --json`; `wl search` is documented as FTS, not a substring matcher. scan.py search-code / list-files unchanged.
